distortions.name: Open top bin
distortions.mechanism: The highest bracket is '$200k and over' - unbounded. Everyone from comfortable to billionaire is one undifferentiated 11%. No top-1%, 0.1%, 0.01% is visible.

distortions.name: Top-coding
distortions.mechanism: Public-use CPS incomes above a threshold are replaced with swap/ceiling values, mechanically capping the very tail that carries the concentration.

distortions.name: Income, not wealth
distortions.mechanism: Census measures a yearly FLOW. Concentration lives in the STOCK (net worth); the wealth Gini (0.85) is nearly double the income Gini (0.49).

distortions.name: Capital gains excluded
distortions.mechanism: Census money income omits realized AND unrealized capital gains - where the top's resources actually accrue (buy-borrow-die). The asset boom is invisible to it.

distortions.name: Quintiles dissolve the tail
distortions.mechanism: Slicing into five 20%-of-population buckets averages the top 0.1% in with the merely-affluent; the action is inside the top bucket's top sliver.

distortions.name: Gini is tail-insensitive
distortions.mechanism: A single scalar dominated by the middle of the distribution; large moves in the top 0.1% share barely move it, so the headline gauge under-reports tail dynamics.

distortions.name: Household, not person
distortions.mechanism: Bucketing by household without size-adjustment; more earners per household and shrinking household size flatter measured 'household income' growth.

sources: Census CPS ASEC income tables; Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts & Survey of Consumer Finances; IRS SOI / World Inequality Database. Figures approximate, recent-year, directional.
